# Modern Portfolio Website Instructions

This is a React + TypeScript + Vite project for a modern, professional portfolio website showcasing full-stack development and AI/ML expertise.

## Design Guidelines
- **Modern Dark Theme**: Primary dark slate gradient background (#0f172a to #334155)
- **Professional Color Palette**: Blue (#3b82f6) and purple (#8b5cf6) gradients for accents
- **Clean Typography**: Inter font family with proper hierarchy
- **Smooth Animations**: Framer Motion for engaging but subtle interactions
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with Tailwind CSS
- **Performance**: Fast loading with optimized images and code splitting

## Core Sections
- **Hero Section**: Eye-catching introduction with gradient text and tech stack preview
- **About Section**: Personal story with professional highlights and fun facts
- **Skills Section**: Comprehensive technical skills with animated progress bars
- **Projects Section**: Featured projects with live demos and GitHub links
- **Contact Section**: Multiple contact methods and social links

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript
- **Build Tool**: Vite for fast development and optimized builds
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS for utility-first styling
- **Animations**: Framer Motion for smooth, performance-conscious animations
- **Icons**: React Icons for consistent iconography
- **Deployment**: Vercel/Netlify optimized

## Animation Principles
- **Scroll-triggered animations**: Elements animate in as they come into view
- **Hover effects**: Subtle scaling and color transitions
- **Performance-first**: Use transform and opacity for smooth 60fps animations
- **Accessibility**: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for users who prefer less motion

## Content Strategy
- **Professional Focus**: Highlight technical skills and project achievements
- **Visual Hierarchy**: Use typography, spacing, and color to guide attention
- **Call-to-Actions**: Clear buttons for project demos, GitHub links, and contact
- **Personal Touch**: Balance professionalism with personality through micro-interactions

## Development Best Practices
- **TypeScript**: Strict type checking for better code quality
- **Component Structure**: Modular, reusable components
- **Performance**: Lazy loading, code splitting, and optimized images
- **SEO**: Proper meta tags, semantic HTML, and structured data
- **Accessibility**: WCAG compliance with keyboard navigation and screen reader support

## Deployment & Optimization
- **Build Process**: Vite for fast builds and modern bundling
- **Asset Optimization**: Compressed images, minified CSS/JS
- **Performance Monitoring**: Web Vitals optimization
- **SEO**: Sitemap, robots.txt, and social media meta tags
